newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India awards June/July HAN at $30-$35/T discount.
newsitem.headline: India awards June/July HAN at $30-$35/T discount.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has awarded its tender to sell 30,000 tonnes of high aromatic naphtha (HAN) for June 30-July 2 lifting at nearly $30 per tonne below Japanese spot naphtha quotes, industry sources said on Monday.
The cargo was awarded on a free-on-board (fob) basis and will be lifted from Cochin on the Indian west coast.
IOC has also awarded a 25,000-tonne cargo of HAN for July 2-4 lifting from Bombay at a discount between $30 and $35 to Japanese spot naphtha quotes, fob.
Both tender closed on June 19 and was valid until June 20.
IOC's last HAN cargo from Cochin, for May 25-27 lifting, was sold by tender to a Dutch trader at $39 per tonne below Japanese spot naphtha quotes, fob basis.
